title: Sir Henry Percy to Cecil, Norham 23 July 1559 (BL Add MS 4136 f.172, DECODE R9256)

steps.what: Downloaded the single DECODE image; found it is a Forbes tracing of four cipher passages plus an unrelated 1562 Sturmius key.
Transcribed 63 signs in 13 words as shape+mark tokens.
CSP Foreign I 1045/1051 and Bain CSP Scotland I 498/501: letter calendared, 'a few words in cipher, deciphered by Cecill'; cipher words not identified.
Checked key records R9257, R9260-R9262 in the same volume for a box alphabet.
Rosicrucian pigpen (shape = cell of three letters, mark = position), all layouts.
Joint word-pattern constraint search under five mark policies, and trigram annealing.
Names from the calendar text (prior, knox, whytlaw, norham castle) placed on repeated words.

outcome.method_basis: The 63 signs of the Forbes tracing were attacked ciphertext-only (pattern search, pigpen layouts, constraint search, annealing, calendar-name cribs) without result; Cecil's decipherment exists on the TNA SP 52/1 original, which is not online.
outcome.notes: Too short to break without the key; Cecil's interlined decipherment on TNA SP 52/1 would settle it.

prior.where: Cecil's contemporary decipherment on the original at TNA SP 52/1 (not online); calendars (CSP Foreign I 1051, CSP Scotland I 501) give the letter's content in summary without saying which words were in cipher

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.
